trigger.description: The workspace has fewer than 50 labeled outcome triples or fewer than 15 distinct labeled queries when the outcome-tuned retrieval-weights shadow policy runs, so the evaluator abstains per the ADR 0070 evidence gate instead of tuning on noise. The run still succeeds and persists an abstained ee.shadow.retrieval_tuning_report.v1; this info entry is the honest signal that the label corpus is too small.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Run cargo fmt --check before release.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json
